title: bug reporter + repo identity: DEFAULT_REPO/README → HexingBot/hivemind, URI-userinfo + _AUTH scrub patterns, confirm gate on the agent filing path (R12)
description: Deep-review sweep #2 (2026-07-06) MEDIUM finding R12 (F14+F15+F38+F43, adversarially confirmed incl. live scrub reproduction). DEFAULT_REPO='lordiwa/agent-framework' (src/framework-bug-report.js:275, baked into dist/report-framework-bug.cjs:181, echoed in commands/report-framework-bug.md:9) is the pre-rebrand upstream, not this product (origin = HexingBot/hivemind; rebrand commit 79f1bad updated neither) — filing always dead-ends or misroutes, so bugs never reach maintainers; README.md:51-52's install example cites the same stale URL. SECRET_PATTERNS has no URI-userinfo rule and the env-var rule omits _AUTH / bare PASSWORD= — bolt://neo4j:hunter2@db:7687 and NEO4J_AUTH=neo4j/hunter2 pass the scrub verbatim (reproduced live; exactly the shapes the brain seam produces and the skill says to include verbatim). The agent filing path (report-framework-bug.md:23-24) has no human confirm before external egress. Full context: synthesis §R12.
acceptance_criteria: DEFAULT_REPO becomes a single shared constant pointing at HexingBot/hivemind; dist/report-framework-bug.cjs rebuilt; README.md install-example URL corrected; commands/report-framework-bug.md matches.

Scrub patterns added with red-first specs: URI-userinfo credentials (scheme://user:pass@host — bolt://neo4j:hunter2@db:7687 must scrub) and env forms *_AUTH= and bare PASSWORD= (NEO4J_AUTH=neo4j/hunter2 must scrub); existing scrub specs still pass.

The agent filing path requires an explicit human confirm-preview of the scrubbed body before any external gh issue create (or is blocked behind a loop-mode gate); the local-file fallback remains confirm-free.
The misleading fallback cause message (GitHub filing dead-ending due to a wrong repo reported as auth/availability) is corrected to name the actual failure.
